title: Maximum Number of Accepted Invitations
goal: Maximize accepted invitations with no participant assigned more than once.
strategy: Use augmenting paths in a bipartite graph. When a desired partner is occupied, recursively reassign their current owner; a successful chain adds one new matched pair.
